description.name: Basic Attack
Burn Attack
description.desc:
Dealing DMG with [Burning Attack] restores [Embers]. Phoenix can hold up to 120 [Embers].
While [Burning Attack] is active, Anti-Interrupt Lv. is increased. Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to immediately follow up with the launcher Action of [Special Attack: Pursuit Slash].

description.name: Basic Attack: Basic Attack Hold
Basic Attack: Alt Attack
Dodge: Dodge
Dash Attack
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch a dashing slash forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Dash forward and perform a rapid slash, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Pursuit Slash
EX Special Attack: Phase 1
EX Special Attack: Phase 2
Energize
description.desc:
When a heavy attack from [EX Special Attack: Part 2], [Basic Attack: Basic Attack hold], or [Ultimate] hits an enemy, gain 1 stack of [Energize];
When [Energize] is active, the next heavy attack will launch an additional attack against the target, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>, and this attack is considered an [EX Special Attack].

description.name: Chain Attack
Ultimate
Ultimate: Entrance
description.desc:
When Phoenix enters the [Downed] state, activates upon switching to Phoenix or when Phoenix enters the field via Quick Assist:
Surrounds herself with flames, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to nearby enemies and continuously recovering her own HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Quick Assist
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dash forward and unleash a rapid slash, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Hurls weapon at the enemy, then retrieves it to unleash a Slash, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
